title: California Condors Rebounded From Just 27 Birds
hook: A species reduced to 27 birds now has a real comeback.
closing: The rescue worked, but preventing lead poisoning determines whether the recovery lasts.
question: Can condors keep recovering?

segments.say: California condors fell to 27 birds, leaving one disaster capable of erasing the species.
California condors rebounded to 500 birds, proving captive breeding reversed a collapse once considered nearly final.
Lead poisoning causes 50% of known California condor deaths, so recovery depends on removing that preventable threat.
